$comment: Computed numbers for the video, filled 29 to 30 Oct from the database (field rows only, is_sample = false) and never typed from memory. null = not read yet: drafts show a marked placeholder, render:final refuses. hidden = the app keeps it private (fewer than 5 teachers behind it): the video shows that in words, never a number.

voice_notes.source: Recordings in Mahesh Bedavatti's field interview (imported on /m/import, 28 Oct), counted in the database; read 29 Oct: interview ead03d6f, 7 notes (intro + 6), 17 chunks

masters.source: lib/field/summary.ts masters: field master teachers with consent on record, as /how 'From the field' shows; read 2026-10-30T11:29Z by scripts/field-numbers.mjs

questions.source: lib/field/summary.ts questions: field questions, private while fewer than 5 different teachers asked; read 2026-10-30T11:29Z by scripts/field-numbers.mjs

worked.source: lib/field/summary.ts worked: field 'it worked' taps, private while fewer than 5 different teachers tried; read 2026-10-30T11:29Z by scripts/field-numbers.mjs

cost_per_teacher_month.source: lib/costs/model.ts perTeacherMonthInr (D74), as /how 'What it costs' shows, rounded as the page rounds it; computed 29 Oct by costModel(): 33.17 a month, shown as ₹33 (about(n, 1)), from docs/evals/latest.json of 24 Oct (235 cases)

voice_seconds.source: Length of his field interview: last audio chunk ends at 341.8 s (7 notes, 5 min 42 s), read 29 Oct. The narration says 'under six minutes'.
